name: Selenia
description: A spirit bound to Crovax's father's service, killed by Crovax on Rath.

description_citations.text: "Timeline". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Crovax freed Selenia from her magical bindings; she chose to leave him.
timeline.quote: Selenia was freed from her magical bindings by the wealthy noble.

citation.text: Selenia (Vanguard Series, 1997), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Selenia now serves Volrath in Rath.
timeline.quote: Selenia now serves the evil Volrath in his home realm of Rath.

citation.text: Selenia (Vanguard Series, 1997), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Crovax watches Selenia lead the Predator to the Weatherlight and feels betrayed.
timeline.quote: Crovax had witnessed Selenia lead the *Predator* to the *Weatherlight*.

citation.text: Enfeeblement (Tempest, 1997), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Selenia freezes and Crovax's blade kills her, fulfilling the curse.
timeline.quote: Crovax's blade found home.

citation.text: Death Stroke (Stronghold, 1998), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Selenia hurt Mirri badly and tore wounds in Crovax's soul that will not close.
timeline.quote: Selenia had hurt Mirri terribly

citation.text: Convalescence (Exodus, 1998), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Selenia admits she cannot resist dark whispers under moonless foreign skies.
timeline.quote: Dark whispers echo in the night, and I cannot resist.

citation.text: Dread of Night (World Championship Decks 1998, 1998), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Radiant prays that Lady Selenia died honorably after her loss to the Phyrexians.
timeline.quote: My finest warrior was lost to the Phyrexians.

citation.text: Persecute (Urza's Saga, 1998), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Selenia freezes and Crovax's blade kills her, shattering the angel and fulfilling the curse that collapses Crovax's mind.
timeline.quote: As the angel shattered like glass, Crovax felt his mind collapse—the curse had been fulfilled.

citation.text: Death Stroke (Beatdown Box Set, 2000), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Starke lies to Crovax that he knows nothing of a letter but has seen Selenia in Rath, then tells him the letter was a trick to draw him away from his family.
timeline.quote: You were lured away from your home and from protecting your family.

citation.text: "Torrent" by Michael G. Ryan. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 12 Feb 2007.

timeline.summary: Selenia catches Gerrard mid-air but he wrests free and falls into the forest canopy.
timeline.quote: Gerrard was caught mid-air by Selenia

citation.text: "Assault on Rath", section "Description". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Greven throws Vhati off the Predator and Vhati is impaled by a branch.
timeline.quote: Vhati met his end as he was impaled by a branch

citation.text: "Assault on Rath", section "Description". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Gerrard returns with Eladamri and the Oracle, having been saved by Selenia, and plans to rescue the captives and reclaim the Legacy.
timeline.quote: revealing that he had been saved by Selenia before managing to escape.

citation.text: "Assault on Rath", section "Description". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: In the Dream Halls Crovax strikes down the real Selenia, her shattered form entering him and making him a vampire.
timeline.quote: In a moment of deep regret, Crovax struck her down

citation.text: "Assault on Rath", section "Description". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Crovax leaves Urborg to join the Weatherlight crew, taking the artifact binding Selenia.
timeline.quote: He took with him the artifact controlling Selenia so that he could be with her.

citation.text: "Crovax", section "Early life". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The Phyrexian agents Morinfen and Gallowbraid slaughter Crovax's family; Rofellos dies and Selenia defeats the Phyrexians.
timeline.quote: Rofellos became the first casualty of the battle.

citation.text: "Crovax", section "Serving aboard Weatherlight". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Crovax shatters the artifact binding Selenia, who flies away, and he is cursed to destroy all that he loves.
timeline.quote: He was now destined to destroy all that he loved.

citation.text: "Crovax", section "Descent into madness". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: On Rath, Crovax sees Selenia leading an attack against the Weatherlight and breaks down.
timeline.quote: Embittered by his love's betrayal, Crovax became obsessed with getting revenge.

citation.text: "Crovax", section "Descent into madness". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Crovax strikes down Selenia, who shatters into shards that warp him into a vampire.
timeline.quote: Crovax's curse had been fulfilled: he had killed the love of his life and had been damned because of it.

citation.text: "Crovax", section "Descent into madness". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: After the Rathi Overlay, Crovax oversees Phyrexian domination of Urborg, executes Tsabo Tavoc, and convinces Gerrard to submit to Yawgmoth.
timeline.quote: This convinced Gerrard to surrender himself to the Dark Lord.

citation.text: "Crovax", section "Reign of Terror". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Gerrard, returned with Yawgmoth's boons, slices Crovax in half; Selenia recovers his normal soul.
timeline.quote: eventually being sliced in half by Gerrard.

citation.text: "Crovax", section "Reign of Terror". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Crovax kills Selenia, which triggers a curse that turns him into a vampire.
timeline.quote: Crovax killed her, but this triggered a curse on him and turned him into a vampire .

citation.text: "Gerrard Capashen", section "Rath and Storm". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Mirri dives in front of Crovax to deflect Selenia's strike and is gravely wounded; Crovax slays Selenia and Tahngarth carries both back to the ship.
timeline.quote: Mirri dove in front of him to deflect one of Selenia's strikes.

citation.text: "Mirri", section "The Weatherlight". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: In an alternate reality seen in Planar Chaos, Mirri strikes the killing blow against Selenia, becomes the vampiric Mirri the Cursed, and is abandoned on Rath.
timeline.quote: it was Mirri who struck the killing blow instead of Crovax

citation.text: "Mirri", section "Alternate reality". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Gallowbraid slays Rofellos and Crovax summons Selenia.
timeline.quote: When Rofellos was slain by Gallowbraid, Crovax used his cursed heirloom to summon the guardian angel Selenia

citation.text: "Rath and Storm", section "A Dark Room". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Selenia wounds Mirri on the bridge to the Dream Halls.
timeline.quote: The angel turns her attack toward the cat warrior, slicing her deep across the belly.

citation.text: "Rath and Storm", section ""Crovax's Tale" ( Kij Johnson )". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Crovax runs Selenia through with his sword.
timeline.quote: Crovax runs her through with his sword

citation.text: "Rath and Storm", section ""Crovax's Tale" ( Kij Johnson )". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Selenia's shards stream into Crovax and Tahngarth saves him from jumping.
timeline.quote: Selenia shatters into countless shards that stream into Crovax's body through his face.

citation.text: "Rath and Storm", section ""Crovax's Tale" ( Kij Johnson )". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Crovax kills Selenia, cursing himself with vampirism.
timeline.quote: Crovax kills Selenia , placing the curse of vampirism on himself.

citation.text: "Timeline", section "Phyrexian Invasion (4205 AR to 4206 AR) [ 16 ] [ 10 ]". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

relations.note: Crovax hopes to find Selenia who abandoned him
relations.quote: Secretly, he hopes in his journeys to find Selenia, the angelic being who abandoned him and his family years ago.

citation.text: Crovax (Vanguard Series, 1997), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.
